rationale.conceptual: The method involves a custom molecular field theory for the Kawasaki spin-exchange model with complex nonlinear kinetic equations (e.g., Eq. 14) and boundary conditions derived from the lattice; thorough understanding of mean-field theory and numerical implementation is needed to correctly reproduce the results.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises five sequential stages: three separate simulation runs (lattice deep quench, near-critical, TDGL) and two post-processing steps to compute averaged profiles. Each simulation involves integrating PDEs for many timesteps, and dependencies require coordinating multiple outputs.
